'''Gir Endac''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the planet [[Mexeluine/Legends|Mexeluine]] who served in the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was present with fellow Wing Guardsmen in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] just prior to the [[Occupation of Bespin]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Endac, alongside fellow Wing Guardsmen [[Corman Jeihn]], [[Pedar Solardo/Legends|Pedar Solardo]], [[Helder Spinoza/Legends|Helder Spinoza]], [[Bialar Selis]], and [[Razell Tameron]], proceeded to ambush an Imperial unit led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sheckil/Legends|Sheckil]] while they were transporting [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to Vader's shuttle, having been secretly notified by Calrissian via Lobot.

At one point in time, Endac helped the accountant [[Samara Kebyc]] track down corrupt officials within the [[Cloud City Miner's Guild]].<ref name="SWI" /> While on duty, he carried a blaster pistol, baton and [[Magnacuffs/Legends|magnacuffs]].<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Behind the scenes==
This originally unnamed character first appeared in [[1980]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. He received his own action figure in [[2001]], though the character photo on the package was heavily modified to better match the figure.<ref name="SWSourcebooks">{{Facebook|username=star-wars-sourcebooks|url=notes/star-wars-sourcebooks/naming-the-cloud-city-wing-guards/714850175231759|name=Star Wars Sourcebooks|date=2014-03-06}}</ref>
